description: Pilot template pairing a **simple-terraform** declaration with topology and security hints. The declaration is intentionally minimal — it seeds the ingestion graph, not a full production module tree.
constraints: No secrets or access keys appear in declaration text
assumptions: Terraform names are indicative; rename to match your workspace conventions
inlineRequirements: Call out every static public IP requirement and justify it
topologyHints: Database tier should not share subnet with application instances
securityBaselineHints: Private endpoints for Azure SQL; deny public network access
